correctness.rationale: Every nonempty palindrome has a unique half-word decomposition; greedy embedding gives an exact necessary-and-sufficient endpoint formula. Binomial sums yield the formal generating function, checked independently against direct 2^n-position enumeration for n<=17 and a separate exact rational recurrence to n=75. Splitting parities and examining the unique simple dominant pole proves analytic uniformity; explicit first and second cumulant derivatives give the stated Gaussian CLT. No finite experiment was extrapolated to infinity.

value.rationale: An exact distribution by palindrome length is a natural refinement of the known counting problem on its classical alternating binary extremizer. The two-variable rational identity supplies all exact length multiplicities and leads to a nontrivial normal law with explicit linear mean and variance, neither of which follows from the published total count alone; it supplies structural baseline data for scattered-palindrome enumeration.
